whatThisIs: [FreshTruck is a non Profit Organization aiming to reduce barriers like transportation and cost, of fresh produce. They can be found throughout Boston communities hosting weekly markets selling fresh-culturally diverse produce. You can go to a market to shop yourself or order online. They accept EBT/SNAP, HIP, credit and debit cards, cash, Apple Pay, OTC networks, and more.]
whoItHelps: Individuals looking for more accessible ways to get fresh produce
There is no income or demographic limitations on who may attend these markets
whatToKnow: Translated prices and listings are available in the FreshTruck market.
If you do not wish to order online but can not shop for yourself, a FreshTruck team member will give you a menu of their offered items and shop for you.
Weekly Markets run on a ticketing system of first come first serve
name: Fresh Truck
